description: DRAFT. A group of identities (for example a household) whose devices may talk to each other by permission. The namespace org.ligatureprotocol is a placeholder; the domain is not yet registered.

main.description: Signed document describing a group: its members, admins, shared devices and policy. Signed by an admin's device key and gossiped among members' devices; there is no group repository.

sharedDevices.description: deviceIds of device principals owned by the group.

acceptance.description: Signature by the member's user-signing key over their acceptance of this membership. See spec chapter 02.

expiresAt.description: For guests: when the membership ends.

policy.description: What group members may do with the group's shared devices when nobody is present. Anything not listed is denied.

unattendedAllow.description: Capability type NSIDs that any member may use on a shared device when no one is present.

promptTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a present person has to answer before a request is treated as denied.
